environment.description: Application deployed as ECS Fargate task behind an internal ALB (scheme=internal, not internet-facing). Traffic reaches the ALB only through API Gateway (REST API, regional endpoint) with a VPC Link to the internal ALB. The API Gateway has a request validator enabled on the GET /api/users/search method with a request model that constrains the 'q' query parameter via JSON Schema pattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{0,30}$'. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a usage plan requiring an x-api-key (Gateway-level, separate from app-level) with throttling at 10 req/sec. The ECS task's security group only allows inbound from the ALB's security group on port 8080. The ALB's security group only allows inbound from the VPC Link ENI security group. No direct internet path to the application exists.

config.network: Internal ALB, private subnets only, SG chain: VPCLink-ENI-SG -> ALB-SG -> ECS-Task-SG
